svg.title: Molebridge
svg.desc: Molebridge: your devices, containers and agents, tunneled out. The mole under its arch sits on a circuit line; NetBird devices on the left reach one exit, which fans out to Mullvad, PIA, NordVPN, or a WireGuard provider through gluetun.

g.text: MULLVAD · PIA · NORDVPN · FOUR MORE VIA GLUETUN
